title: Prime Minister congratulates Thulasimathi Murugesan on winning Silver at the Asian Para Games
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Thulasimathi Murugesan on winning Silver in Women’s Singles SU5 at the Asian Para Games. Shri Modi stated that her performance is a proud moment for Indian badminton, expressing hope that she continues to work hard, scale new heights, and bring more laurels to the nation. In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared: "Congratulations to Thulasimathi Murugesan on winning Silver in Women’s Singles SU5 at the Asian Para Games! Her performance is a proud moment for Indian badminton. May she continue to work hard, scale new heights and bring more laurels to the nation: PM @narendramodi" Congratulations to Thulasimathi Murugesan on winning Silver in Women’s Singles SU5 at the Asian Para Games!
